# Configuration reference

Settings of `Config` in package `example.com/pipelineapp/cmd/app`, bound by `Bind`.

Each setting is read from its environment variable first, then from the secret store
(secret settings only), then from the YAML config files (later files win), then its
default. An empty value counts as unset. A setting without a default is required
unless it is optional. Secret settings are never read from config files and never
printed. Lists use commas in environment variables and YAML lists in files.

`nanostack gen config` checks every default against its type and validation, except
defaults of types that parse themselves (encoding.TextUnmarshaler, such as
slog.Level): those are checked when the service starts.

| Setting | Env | Type | Default | Required | Secret | Validation | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `greeting.text` | `GREETING_TEXT` | string | `hello` | no | no |  | Greeting text. |
